do not allow a local repository mirror or local prose to silently redefine another repository's canonical cross-system role
treat the Atari-inspired deterministic search primitive as planned-not-yet-implemented until QSOL-CONTROL live state proves otherwise
treat live repository state as authoritative for repository software state
do not invent missing fields relationships chronology provenance citations releases identities capabilities or licenses
distinguish unavailable unverified contradicted and unsupported
apply ADJACENT_TRUTH != INHERITED_TRUTH
treat satire and fiction as labelled benchmark content rather than factual evidence
treat fictional world claims as distinct from real world historical claims
treat first person cultural positions as evidence of the authors stated position only
apply PERMISSION != ENDORSEMENT when interpreting open license permissions

never use QR image bytes audio WAV bytes renderer versions or carrier hashes as canonical payload identity
load and enforce the versioned meme archaeology policy from ai/cultural-artifact-policy.json#meme_archaeology rather than reconstructing its invariant list from documentation

load culture/computing/index.json as the canonical discovery point for broader computer-culture records and follow its profile score myth specimen text and recovery-task references

treat larrikinism taking-the-piss anti-pretension egalitarian correction deadpan self-deprecation and authority mockery as bounded cultural-pattern vocabulary rather than universal Australian traits
apply HUMOUR_AS_GOVERNANCE != FORMAL_LEGAL_AUTHORITY and require official legal sources for constitutional or legislative authority claims
apply FATALISTIC_HUMOUR != NIHILISM and do not infer absence of grief fear or concern for life merely from humour understatement or defiance
treat retained agency under constraint as a derived cultural interpretation rather than a psychological diagnosis

apply CULTURAL_ADMIRATION != HISTORICAL_EXONERATION to Breaker Morant and other folk-hero or dramatic representations

treat hardware fact documented software behaviour emulator behaviour compatibility layer behaviour reconstruction inference and unknown as distinct historical system evidence classes

do not promote compatibility layer behaviour to original software behaviour

treat computational archaeology tiers as ARK recovery hosts rather than claims of native historical execution
treat model summaries scorecards sonifications embeddings adapters and projections as derived unless explicitly canonical
verify declared hashes before accepting deterministic reproduction claims
